title: ICTS Dashboard QAQC Report File Manifest Schema
description: A schema to describe individual QA/QC report files stored in the ICTS Dashboard Analysis S3 bucket. Each object represents a single report file and includes the metadata necessary to support downstream linking to participant, analyte, or experiment records, as well as any associated secondary files (e.g., plots, summary tables).

file_name.description: The name of the report file, including extension.

file_path.description: The full path to the file within the S3 bucket or equivalent storage location.

created_date.description: The date the report was generated.

file_size.description: The size of the report file in bytes.

file_summary.description: Short description of the report contents (e.g., QC metrics summary, FastQC results, duplication stats).

source_analysis_file.description: A pointer to the analysis file this QAQC report pertains to.

associated_files.description: Optional array of files associated with this report (e.g., images, data tables, downloadable artifacts).
